toxicity.Notes: Single i.p. injection on day 1, 24 h after i.p. inoculation of 6 x 10^6 Ehrlich ascites tumour cells, in female CF1 mice of 20-25 g, ten animals per dose group and five control groups of ten. Doses rose in steps of 20 mg/kg in saline; above 200-300 mg/kg 10% dimethylsulfoxide was added to the injection solution. These are therefore lethality values measured in tumour-bearing, not healthy, animals: the authors counted deaths within 7 days of injection as toxic and later deaths as deaths from disease. The experiment ran to day 120 after transplantation. LD50 = 260 mg/kg and LD100 = 300 mg/kg are named by the authors in Table 1; the method of calculation is not stated. The optimal dose range 140-220 mg/kg gave a maximal cure rate of 100%. No MTD is named. Dose_basis (column removed 2026-11-16e): compound_mass.
